title: Vegetables, fruit, grains, herbs, spices, sweeteners and other plant pantry items
notes: Confirmed WP3 policy: alternative flours do not inherit wheat flour; each follows its source ingredient because catalog flour denotes ordinary wheat flour and gluten safety is handled separately.
Confirmed WP3 policy: use group:allium for onion, garlic, shallot, leek, green onion and chive so one household exclusion can cover the allium family.
Confirmed WP3 policy: hot fresh chillies and chilli-based powders inherit chili_pepper; bell_pepper and black_pepper do not.
Confirmed WP3 policy: garlic_salt, onion_salt, celery_salt and seasoned_salt inherit salt because a household avoiding salt would avoid these blends.
Confirmed WP3 policy: individual berry varieties inherit berries.

Extract policy: almond, citrus, mint, coconut, rum, vanilla and other commercial flavour extracts may contain alcohol as a solvent; pandan extract evidence is a Southeast Asian grocery flavouring and is treated as non-alcoholic.

Packaged seasoning policy: use may_contain only where the catalog evidence or customary product directly supports meat or seafood; generic spice-only packets remain unlinked when composition is not evidenced.
accepted_by remains null until the package owner personally reads and accepts every drafted entry.

almond_extract.reason: Recipes use concentrated almond extract; natural versions derive almond flavour and commercial extracts may use alcohol solvent.

asian_seasoning.reason: The sole recipe gives only a generic Asian seasoning label, with no evidence of a particular meat, seafood or plant base.

bonito_flakes.reason: Dried bonito flakes are made from skipjack, a tuna species, and the catalog has tuna as the nearest fish family id.

cheese_tortellini.reason: The recipe explicitly uses frozen cheese-filled tortellini, so a guest avoiding cheese would avoid this pasta.

coconut_extract.reason: Measured coconut extract supplies concentrated coconut flavour and commercial versions may use an alcohol-based solvent.

coconut_flavoring.reason: The recipe names bottled coconut flavoring; it may use coconut-derived flavour and may carry an alcohol solvent.

dashida.reason: The recipe identifies Dashida as Korean beef-flavoured roasted salt, a beef seasoning avoided by guests excluding beef.

egg_noodles.reason: This catalog id covers egg and Hokkien noodles; egg is a defining dough ingredient under the confirmed egg-food policy.

jasmine_flavoring.reason: The recipe gives an unspecified commercial jasmine flavoring, which may use alcohol as the aromatic carrier.

kimchi.reason: Prepared cabbage kimchi commonly contains fish sauce or fermented shrimp, although explicitly vegan batches exist.

lemon_extract.reason: Recipes measure lemon extract as concentrated lemon flavour; commercial extracts commonly use alcohol as the carrier.

marshmallow.reason: Conventional large and miniature marshmallows commonly use gelatin, while vegetarian formulations also exist.

milk_chocolate.reason: Milk chocolate is a finished confection, not a form of milk; dairy safety remains the allergen and diet rules' responsibility.

mint_extract.reason: The recipe uses measured mint extract; it concentrates mint flavour and commercial extracts may contain alcohol solvent.

nasi_goreng_spice_mix.reason: Packaged nasi goreng seasoning may include dried shrimp or shrimp paste, although brands and homemade spice mixes vary.

orange_extract.reason: Recipe evidence includes orange extract and orange oil; both concentrate orange flavour, while extract may use alcohol solvent.

pandan_extract.reason: The waffle recipes use Southeast Asian grocery pandan extract as concentrated pandan liquid, with no recipe evidence of alcohol.

pho_spice.reason: The recipe identifies a packet sized for broth but provides no evidence that the pho spice packet itself contains meat.

rum_extract.reason: Rum extract is concentrated rum flavour rather than rum itself, but commercial extracts may retain an alcohol carrier.

stuffing_mix.reason: Evidence includes explicitly chicken-flavoured boxed stuffing alongside herb-seasoned mixes, so chicken is possible but not universal.

vanilla.reason: Nearly all evidence writes vanilla extract; it derives flavour from vanilla beans and commercial extract commonly contains alcohol.

vanilla_bean.reason: Whole split vanilla pods are the raw spice, not the catalog's alcohol-prone vanilla extract; the extract instead inherits the bean.

white_chocolate.reason: White chocolate is a finished cocoa-butter confection with no chocolate family id and does not inherit milk under policy.

adobo_seasoning.reason: Recipe evidence uses an all-purpose peppered adobo seasoning blend, not a food with one dependable ingredient parent.

agave.reason: Agave nectar is a distinct plant syrup, and the catalog provides no broader syrup or agave plant parent id.

allspice.reason: Whole and ground allspice are forms of one standalone spice, not a mixture with a catalog parent.

almond_flour.reason: The evidence alternates almond meal and almond flour; both are ground almond, not the catalog's ordinary wheat flour.

almond_milk.reason: Unsweetened almond milk is a beverage made from almonds and is not dairy milk under the confirmed policy.

anise.reason: Recipes use both star anise and anise seed under this broad spice id, with no narrower shared catalog parent.

annatto.reason: Annatto seed and powder are forms of the same standalone colouring spice without another catalog family id.

apple.reason: Fresh sliced, diced and whole apples make this the family root for apple-derived catalog ingredients.

apple_pie_spice.reason: Apple pie spice is a dry cinnamon-led spice blend used to season apples; it does not contain apple itself.

applesauce.reason: Unsweetened and ordinary applesauce are cooked purées made principally from apples.

apricot.reason: Fresh and dried apricots are the same fruit family and have no broader catalog parent.

arrowroot.reason: Arrowroot powder and starch are a standalone plant starch with no matching source-plant or starch family id.

artichoke.reason: Whole artichokes and canned or marinated hearts form this vegetable family without another catalog parent.

arugula.reason: Fresh arugula leaves are a distinct leafy vegetable and no other catalog id represents its family.

asian_pear.reason: Asian and Korean pears in the recipe evidence are crisp cultivated varieties of pear.

asparagus.reason: Fresh trimmed asparagus spears are a distinct vegetable family with no suitable catalog parent.

avocado.reason: Whole ripe avocados and their flesh make this the root id for avocado-derived products.

baguette.reason: French baguettes and banh mi loaves in the evidence are long crusty varieties of bread.

baking_chocolate.reason: Unsweetened, semisweet and German baking chocolates share this root, and no generic chocolate id exists.

baking_powder.reason: Baking powder is a standalone chemical leavener rather than a form of another catalog ingredient.

baking_soda.reason: Baking soda or soda is a distinct alkaline leavener with no suitable ingredient parent.

bamboo_shoot.reason: Fresh and canned sliced bamboo shoots form a distinct vegetable family in the catalog.

banana.reason: Fresh, sliced and mashed bananas form the family root for edible banana-fruit preparations.

banana_leaf.reason: Banana leaves are cooking wrappers from the plant, not the edible banana fruit represented by the banana id.

barley.reason: Pearl and cooked barley are forms of this standalone cereal grain without a broader catalog parent.

basil.reason: Fresh and dried basil leaves make this the root herb id for named basil varieties.

bay_leaf.reason: Whole and crumbled bay leaves are a distinct culinary herb with no other catalog family id.

bean_sprouts.reason: Evidence includes generic and mung bean sprouts, so no single bean source is guaranteed by this id.

beet.reason: Fresh, cooked and canned beetroot are forms of one root-vegetable family.

bell_pepper.reason: Green, red and other sweet capsicums are bell peppers, not the hot chili_pepper family under the confirmed policy.

berbere.reason: Berbere is an Ethiopian red-pepper spice blend used in explicitly spicy dishes, so chili pepper is a defining base.

berries.reason: Generic recipe lines explicitly allow raspberry, blackberry or blueberry, making berries the family root.

bilimbi.reason: Bilimbi is a distinct sour tropical fruit used whole, with no suitable broader catalog parent.

biscuit_dough.reason: Refrigerated canned biscuit dough is a prepared dough product without a biscuit or dependable flour parent id.

biscuit_mix.reason: Bisquick and generic baking mix are compound prepared mixes with no single dependable catalog parent.

bitter_melon.reason: Sliced ampalaya or bitter melon is its own gourd vegetable and has no generic melon parent id.

black_pepper.reason: Ground peppercorn is black pepper, botanically and culinarily distinct from hot Capsicum chilli peppers.

blackberry.reason: Frozen blackberries are a named berry variety under the confirmed berries policy.

blueberry.reason: Fresh and frozen blueberries are a named variety within the catalog's generic berries family.

bok_choy.reason: Baby and mature bok choy or pak choi form a distinct leafy vegetable family.

bread.reason: Sliced white, wheat and French loaves make bread the catalog root for bread-derived foods.

bread_flour.reason: Strong bread flour is a high-protein wheat flour used to make bread, not a product made from bread.

bread_mix.reason: White bread mix is a dry preparation used to make bread, rather than bread itself or a product made from it.

breadcrumbs.reason: Fresh, soft, seasoned and dry bread crumbs are all produced from bread.

broccoli.reason: Broccoli heads, florets and broccolini uses make this the root id for broccoli preparations.

broccoli_slaw.reason: Prepared broccoli slaw and broccoli coleslaw mixes are shredded predominantly from broccoli stems.

brown_rice.reason: Cooked and uncooked whole-grain brown rice are a direct variety of rice.

brown_rice_flour.reason: Brown rice flour is ground whole-grain rice and a rice-flour variety, not ordinary wheat flour.

brown_sugar.reason: Light and dark packed brown sugar are direct varieties of the generic sugar family.

brussels_sprouts.reason: Whole, halved and shredded Brussels sprouts form their own brassica vegetable family.

buckwheat.reason: Whole buckwheat used for blini is a distinct pseudocereal with no matching catalog parent.

bulgur.reason: Recipe evidence identifies bulgur as cracked wheat, but the catalog has no wheat family id to record that ancestry.

burdock_root.reason: Whole gobo or burdock root is a distinct root vegetable without another catalog family id.

buttered_breadcrumbs.reason: Every use explicitly calls for bread crumbs prepared with butter, so both components are defining.

butternut_squash.reason: Whole and cubed butternut squash are a named winter-squash variety.

butterscotch_chips.reason: Packaged butterscotch chips or morsels are a standalone confection with no butterscotch family id.

cabbage.reason: Green, napa and generic shredded cabbage make this the root id for cabbage-derived foods.
